## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Valencia, Spain. It starts at 31 Carrer del Mar.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> The Hortensia Herrero Art Centre, in the old Valeriola Palace, captures the history of the city from Roman to Christian times. It's a unique place in Valencia to explore the past.
>
> With a general entry, you can view the Hortensia Herrero Collection, tour the building, and learn its history at your own pace.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €13.12. It was rated 4.7 out of 5 from 351 ratings and 156 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
